title: Final Fight: Harbor Justice
raw_description: Take back the waterfront in Final Fight: Harbor Justice, an arcade-style 2D brawler with two playable fighters. Choose powerful Nessa or quick-footed Ivo, explore the docks and city blocks, and face patrols with readable attack warnings. Punch, jump, block, grab and throw enemies, pick up pipes, and smash crates for supplies. Fight through the scrolling campaign, demolition bonus rounds and boss encounters while local checkpoints keep your progress safe. Detailed character artwork, recorded impacts, waterfront ambience and an original arcade groove bring the uprising to life. Play with keyboard and mouse or on-screen touch controls.

title: Holecraft.io
raw_description: Enter a chaotic block-eating adventure where size is everything! Control a hungry black hole, move around the map, and swallow blocks, objects, and structures to grow larger. Start small and consume everything you can find to increase your size and power. As you grow, bigger blocks become available and you can clear the environment faster. Compete against the clock, collect as much as possible, and become the biggest hole on the map. How large can you grow?

title: Galaxy Pop
raw_description: Galaxy Pop is a cosmic bubble shooter in outer space. Aim your blaster and shoot colorful bubbles, match three or more of the same color to pop them, and watch the bubbles below fall. Shots are limited, so aim carefully and bounce off the walls to reach tricky spots. Play 1000 levels, some with special goals: rescue the aliens, collect the UFOs or collect the eggs. Stuck? Use boosters: Color Pop clears one color, Hook drops a bubble and everything below it, Blast destroys the bubbles around your tap. Complete daily quests, spin the lucky wheel and open the hourly reward chest.

title: Ranch Empire
raw_description: Ranch Empire - build a 3D ranch tycoon empire right in your browser. No download. Start with a bare patch and a dog. Plant fields, raise chickens and cows, breed horses, hire farmhands, and grow into a sprawling ranch with vehicles, a dock, and a marina. Then the wilds push back. Wolves circle the pen. Bears raid the henhouse. Blizzards roll in. Survive - or pay the price. FEATURES • Open-world 3D ranch with tractors, ATVs, horses, and boats • Live multiplayer boat racing - invite friends, climb the leaderboard • Prone-sniper hunting mini-game (deer, stag, fox, hare) • Wolf + bear attacks, blizzards, droughts, plague crisis
